projects.title: Real-time Financial Dashboard
projects.description: Create a dashboard that displays stock market data in real-time with multiple visualization types.
projects.summary: A comprehensive real-time financial dashboard that displays stock market data with multiple visualization types, technical indicators, and historical comparisons.
projects.challenge: Creating a dashboard that could handle real-time data updates without performance degradation while providing intuitive controls for users to customize their view.
projects.solution: Implemented efficient state management with React Query for caching and automatic refetching, used websockets for real-time updates, and optimized chart rendering with Recharts.
results: Real-time data updates with less than 200ms latency
Support for 50+ different stock symbols simultaneously
Custom technical indicators (RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands)
Historical data comparison across multiple timeframes

projects.title: Interactive Data Explorer
projects.description: Build a tool that allows users to upload CSV/Excel files and interactively explore the data with dynamically generated visualizations.
projects.summary: An interactive tool that allows users to upload CSV/Excel files and explore their data through dynamically generated visualizations and summary statistics.
projects.challenge: Handling various file formats and data structures while automatically suggesting appropriate visualizations based on data types.
projects.solution: Built a robust data parser supporting multiple formats, implemented automatic data type detection, and created a recommendation engine for visualization types.
results: Support for CSV, Excel, and JSON file formats
Automatic detection of data types and relationships
Dynamic chart generation based on data structure
Interactive filtering and data transformation tools

projects.title: ML Model Playground
projects.description: Develop an interface for users to interact with pre-trained machine learning models and see predictions in real-time.
projects.summary: An interactive playground for experimenting with pre-trained machine learning models, allowing users to adjust parameters and see predictions in real-time.
projects.challenge: Making complex ML models accessible to non-technical users while maintaining accuracy and performance in the browser.
projects.solution: Leveraged TensorFlow.js for browser-based inference, created intuitive parameter controls, and implemented visual explanations for model predictions.
results: Support for multiple model types (classification, regression, clustering)
Interactive parameter tuning with instant results
Explainable AI features showing feature importance

projects.title: Business KPI Tracker
projects.description: Create a comprehensive dashboard for tracking business KPIs with drill-down capabilities and alerts.
projects.summary: A comprehensive business intelligence dashboard for tracking key performance indicators with drill-down capabilities, alerts, and customizable views.
projects.challenge: Creating a flexible system that could accommodate different business needs while maintaining a clean, intuitive interface.
projects.solution: Built a modular component system allowing for customizable KPI cards, implemented a flexible data model, and created an alerting system for threshold monitoring.
results: Customizable KPI cards with various visualization options
Historical trend analysis with predictive forecasting

projects.title: Geospatial Data Visualizer
projects.description: Build an interactive map-based visualization tool for exploring geographic data patterns.
projects.summary: An interactive map-based visualization tool for exploring geographic data patterns with support for various data overlays and clustering algorithms.
projects.challenge: Handling large geospatial datasets efficiently while providing smooth interactions and multiple overlay options.
projects.solution: Implemented efficient clustering algorithms, used tile-based rendering for performance, and created a flexible layer system for data overlays.

projects.title: A/B Test Results Analyzer
projects.description: Develop a tool for uploading, analyzing, and visualizing A/B test results with statistical significance calculations.
projects.summary: A statistical analysis tool for A/B test results featuring automated significance testing, confidence interval calculations, and visual comparisons.
projects.challenge: Making complex statistical concepts accessible to marketers and product managers without a statistics background.
projects.solution: Created clear visualizations of statistical concepts, implemented automated test selection based on data characteristics, and provided plain-language explanations of results.
